newsitem.title: UK: UK's Major pays tribute to Compton.
newsitem.headline: UK's Major pays tribute to Compton.

text.p: British Prime Minister on Wednesday paid tribute to cricket's golden boy Denis Compton, who has died in hospital at the age of 78.
A sombre Major took time ofF from the election campaign trail to speak about his admiration for one of Britain's all time sporting greats.

"There'll be a tear in many an eye at the sad news about Denis Compton. He was the great cavalier of cricket. Anyone who ever saw him play cricket has an imperishable memory of one of the greatest sportsmen of our time.

"As long as cricket is played, I think people will remember Denis Compton and the way he played it. As long as cricket is talked about they'll remember Denis Compton and I don't think for any cricketer there can be a better epitaph than that."
Major, a lifelong cricket fan, was told of Compton's death wthin minutes of its being announced. --London Newsroom +44-171-542-7947
